commit.message:
Bump ODK Central to v2026.3.2 (pyxform-http v4.5.0) (#190)

* Bump ODK Central image pins (v2026.3.2, pyxform-http v4.5.0)

* Give the attachment download test its own form ID

Both tests in test-form_version_attachment_download.R built the ID
ruodk_vattd_<timestamp>. The first test is short enough that the second
can compute the same second, then create the form after the first test
soft-deleted it. Central keeps deleted form IDs reserved and answers
HTTP 400 (code 400.16, deletedFormExists). Use a distinct prefix.

* Upload coverage only when Codecov accepts it

Codecov rejects tokenless uploads for PR branches with HTTP 400
("Token required because branch is protected"), so test-coverage failed
after every test passed. Run the suite through covr::package_coverage()
first: a test failure still fails the step. Then upload with
CODECOV_TOKEN when it is set, or tokenless on pushes to the default
branch.

* Give the draft attachment list test its own form ID

test-form_draft_attachment_link.R runs just before this file, uses
ruodk_dattl_<timestamp>, and deletes its form at exit. Both files could
land in the same second, so the list test re-created a reserved,
soft-deleted ID and Central answered HTTP 400 (code 400.16,
deletedFormExists). Use its own prefix.
